expected_outcomes: Tokens and components have stable, semantic, portable names and mappings.
required_actions: Use primitive, semantic, component, and platform output layers.
expected_documents: Token taxonomy, component matrix, code map, and parity report.
acceptance: Canonical tokens are not dotted or appearance-only names.
verification: Run token, parity, visual, and accessibility review.
evidence: Export, parity report, tests, and release record.
failure_conditions: Circular aliases, duplicate sources, or design-code drift.
exceptions: Record scope, replacement plan, owner, and expiry.
